svg.title: How Solace scores a patient
svg.desc: At check-in the patient's words go through safety rules in 20 languages, the trained model, the red-flag checklist and an optional AI check; the most urgent answer wins and the patient joins the live nurse queue. At the bedside the nurse enters vital signs, the model re-checks, and the safety floor can only raise the score. The queue and the patient's phone update.

svg.text: A nurse always makes the final call. The safety rules get the last word over the model,

text.font-family: 'DM Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: because the model learned from made-up data and its real-world accuracy is unknown.
